name: Adafruit IO
tagline: Hobbyist IoT platform for sensor feeds, dashboards, and device data via REST and MQTT.
description: Adafruit IO is a cloud platform for connecting sensors, devices, and dashboards. Developers create feeds (time-series data streams), groups, and dashboards, then publish or subscribe over REST and MQTT. It is popular for hobbyist and educational IoT projects with Arduino, CircuitPython, and Raspberry Pi, offering API keys, rate-limited free and paid tiers, and webhooks for automation.

auth.details: API key via X-AIO-Key header (or ?X-AIO-Key= query param). Self-serve account signup; key from Adafruit IO profile.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free: limited data rate and retention; exact 2026 limits from pricing page if confirmed
pricing.paid_plans: IO+ paid plans for higher rate limits, more feeds, longer retention

use_cases: publish a sensor reading to a named feed
list all feeds for an Adafruit IO account
get the latest value from a temperature feed
create a new data feed for a device
subscribe to MQTT updates for a feed
